This kinase is also the target of CID 21778290, which further links Npc115753 to SNU-387. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that Npc115753 may interact with SNU-387 via this kinase pathway. The evidence is consistent across multiple paths, reinforcing the hypothesis that Npc115753 and SNU-387 are connected through a shared target of a protein kinase. However, the exact mechanism of interaction remains uncertain, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the biological relevance of this relationship.
